about: The `pages_read` table, published whole. See /api/schema for its grain. This file is part 8 of 9 for fy 2017.

rows.proof: The identity the page states in its own numbered headings (1)(2)(3)(4) against APPROVED ASSESSMENT FY2018. 12 of 18 towns close exactly; six miss by $1, which is the whole-dollar display rounding described in this group’s proof.

The CHANGE column is a DIFFERENCE of two displayed figures rather than a sum, so rounding cannot accumulate in it, and it closes on all 18 towns with nothing to spare. That is what separates this page’s residuals from a misread.

rows.proof: `ASSESSMENT HISTORY / 1998-2017`, PDF page 149 of the FY2017 annual town report -- the Montachusett Regional Vocational Technical School District's assessment on each of its 18 member towns, for 20 school years. A STATE/REGIONAL DOCUMENT REPRODUCED IN THE TOWN REPORT: the publisher is Monty Tech, not Lunenburg. THE PAGE IS LANDSCAPE, PRINTED SIDEWAYS, AND ITS TEXT LAYER IS MIRRORED -- every word arrives with its characters reversed (`YROTSIH TNEMSSESSA`, `GRUBNENUL`, `LATOT`), the FY2014 defect recorded in notes/process/READING-A-REPORT-PAGE.md. Reversing each word recovers it exactly; the LAYOUT is not mirrored, so a constant-top band in the file is a COLUMN on the page and x increases down the page's rows. THE PRINTED HEADER, read off the rendered page left to right: `SCHOOL YEAR | ASHBY | BARRE | FITCHBURG | GARDNER | HARVARD | HUBBARDSTON | LUNENBURG | ROYALSTON | STERLING | WINCHENDON | ASHBURNHAM | ATHOL | PETERSHAM | PHILLIPSTON | PRINCETON | TEMPLETON | WESTMINSTER | HOLDEN | TOTAL | % CHANGE`. ROWS ARE PLACED BY COLUMN POSITION AND NOT BY ORDER: the row ruler is the SCHOOL YEAR column's own 20 labels, measured pitch 12.791pt, band half of that, and no figure on the page is unplaced. HOLDEN prints 18 values, not 20 -- it is BLANK for 1999-2000 and 1998-1999 -- and an absent column stays absent rather than shifting its neighbours. FOUR INDEPENDENT PROOFS. (1) The 18 town figures sum to the printed TOTAL in all 20 years, within the declared tolerance; 8 of the 20 close EXACTLY and the largest residual is $3. (2) All 19 printed % CHANGE values reproduce from the TOTAL column as (TOTAL_n - TOTAL_n+1)/TOTAL_n+1, to better than 0.005 percentage points, which proves both the TOTAL column and the row ORDER. (3) The same report prints this TOTAL series twice more and both agree exactly: page 142's `Community Assessments` row gives 8,682,724 / 9,441,464 / 10,039,328 / 10,120,930 / 10,314,076 for 13-14 to 17-18 with the same 1.91% change, and page 141's `TOTAL ASSESSMENT (All Budgets)` gives $10,120,930 and $10,314,076. (4) Page 148, COMMUNITY ASSESSMENTS, prints this page's two most recent columns per town: all 19 values of `APPROVED ASSESSMENT FY'2018` and all 19 of `APPROVED ASSESSMENT FY2017` -- 38 figures -- agree with this reading EXACTLY, and page 148 is a PHOTOGRAPH read by eye while this one is a text layer, so the two readings are independent. EVERY MONEY FIGURE ON THIS PAGE IS A WHOLE-DOLLAR DISPLAY OF AN AMOUNT THAT CARRIES CENTS, so a printed total is the rounded TRUE sum and not the sum of the rounded parts. A sum of n such displays can therefore miss its printed total by up to n/2 dollars; the widest sum here has 18 addends, so the DECLARED TOLERANCE IS $9 -- derived from the page's own precision, not fitted to the residuals, which never exceed $3. WHAT ESTABLISHES ROUNDING RATHER THAN A MISREAD is the one column that carries no cents: FOUNDATION ENROLLMENT on page 148 is a COUNT, and its 18 values tie to the printed Total 1,496 EXACTLY, while every money column beside it misses by 1 or 2. On page 149 the same contrast appears as 19 of 19 printed % CHANGE values reproducing from the TOTAL column to four decimal places while the 18 town figures miss their own printed total by at most $3.

rows.proof: `FY'18 OMNIBUS BUDGET:` as voted at the 2 May 2017 Annual Town Meeting, PDF pages 168-169 of the FY2017 annual town report. THE PAGES CARRY THEIR OWN TEXT LAYER -- pdfplumber returns 476 and 155 words -- so the characters are exact and no digit here can have been misread; the only open question is the document's own arithmetic. THE PRINTED HEADER, on page 168: `LINE # | ACCOUNT | FY18`. Page 168 prints the table in TWO PANELS side by side (x 70-300 and x 310-540) and page 169 in one (x 70-300); each panel is bounded and banded separately, because reading across the page pairs a General Government line with a Protection line. 91 NUMBERED LINE ITEMS, 1 to 82 with letter suffixes 3A 3B 13A 14A 43A 61A 72A 79A 79B, WITH NO GAP IN THE NUMBERING -- which is the check the table supplies about its own completeness. 12 section totals, 6 subtotals, and a printed `Total Omnibus $35,690,393.70`. TEN OF THE TWELVE SECTION TOTALS FOOT THEIR OWN LINE ITEMS TO THE CENT, and Total Protection foots its four subtotals exactly once Subtotal Police is corrected (see below). TWO COLUMNS ARE CHECKED AGAINST THE SAME PRINTED Total Omnibus AND BOTH ARE ATTESTED, in opposite directions, each isolating ONE misprint. (1) The 91 line items sum to $35,690,393.19, exactly $0.51 short, which is the whole of the Total Health & Sanitation over-print: lines 54 to 58 sum to $70,866.44 (33,883.00 + 24,707.95 + 11,275.49 + 0 + 1,000.00) against a printed $70,866.95. (2) The 12 section totals sum to $35,690,392.84, exactly $0.86 short, which is the whole of the Total Public Library under-print: line 82 `Lunenburg Public Library` prints $381,709.86 and the section total below it prints $381,709.00. Total Omnibus agrees with the CORRECTED Library figure to the cent, so the town's own grand total places that error in the printed Total Public Library line. Neither residual can be a reading error: a wrong digit anywhere else would break one of the ten footing sections. WHICH FIGURE IS WRONG IN HEALTH & SANITATION IS NOT ESTABLISHED. The same table is REPRINTED in this report at pages 155-158, inside the Article 8 text, and the reprint prints the identical five lines and the identical $70,866.95 total -- so the two printings agree and the 51 cents is in both. Several single-line corrections would close it and the document does not say which.

A MALFORMED FIGURE PRINTED ON THE PAGE, not an artefact of our reading. Page 168 prints `Subtotal Police  $  1,4633,881.75` -- a four-digit thousands group -- and the reprint at page 156 prints the identical string, so the defect is the document's and is in both printings. The value is established twice over and is $1,633,881.75: its own four lines, 39 Police Department 1,543,198.75 + 40 Police Lock Up 80,060.00 + 41 Injury Leave 5,623.00 + 42 Police/Fire Med Expenses 5,000.00; and `Total Protection $2,941,492.35`, which that figure closes with the other three subtotals (870,622.09 + 255,718.71 + 181,269.80) to the cent. The figure is recorded here at its established value and the page's own string is quoted above, because 1,4633,881.75 parses to 14,633,881.75 and that is not what the page means.
